title: Implement PlantStateSnapshot projection foundation and evidence-ref update rules
verify: PlantStateSnapshot/read-model projection updates from persisted observation, measurement, and photo refs only.
Missing, stale, conflicting, unauthorized, or untrusted evidence maps to explicit state labels.
evidence_required: Unit test output for PlantStateSnapshot status/freshness mapping.
Evidence refs showing runtime state depends on persisted source records, not timeline/photo/UI artifacts.
constraints: PostgreSQL/read model is mutable runtime authority for PlantStateSnapshot values.
Timeline, photo manifests/files, UI Feed cards, raw chat, and raw provider output are evidence/artifact layers only.
invariants: Agent hypotheses cannot create confirmed Plant state without owning FT-011 rules and human review or follow-up evidence.
Photo refs and timeline refs may be evidence refs only.
verification_targets: Missing/stale/conflicting evidence maps to unknown, probable, or conflict rather than confirmation.
